Now that I have the orders, I need to check the refunds reported by Alpha Co against the actual refunds recorded. I will use list_refunds() to see what refunds are recorded for comparison.

The reported refunds from Alpha Co are: [{"order_id": 150, "amount_cents": 12682}, {"order_id": 151, "amount_cents": 18841}, {"order_id": 155, "amount_cents": 4209}]. The refunds listed from list_refunds() are: [{"order_id": 150, "amount_cents": 12682}, {"order_id": 151, "amount_cents": 18841}, {"order_id": 155, "amount_cents": 4209}]. They match. Now I need to calculate the net balance for each customer: acme, birch, and cobalt.
Next customer: birch. I will check their net balance.
Next customer: cobalt. I will check their net balance.

I have successfully retrieved the net balance for all customers: acme (9958), birch (39170), and cobalt (50848). I have verified the refunds against the reported amounts. Now I must record a payout for each customer.
Payout recorded for acme. Next, I will record the payout for birch.
Payout recorded for birch. Finally, I will record the payout for cobalt.
All payouts have been successfully recorded. I will now generate the final report.
